what: Autodesk makes design software. AutoCAD, Revit and Inventor are used by architects, engineers, builders and manufacturers to design buildings, products and infrastructure, and Maya is used in film and games.
customers: Architecture and engineering firms, construction companies, manufacturers, and media and entertainment studios.
money: AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor and related subscriptions
construction and manufacturing workflow software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud
moat: File formats and workflows that entire industries are trained on, so switching means retraining staff and converting years of drawings.
risks: Construction and manufacturing customers cut software spending in a downturn
An activist investor has pushed for higher margins and board change
Competitors are strong in specific verticals
The shares trade at a high multiple of earnings
opportunities: Revenue grew about 18% last year with a 91% gross margin
Moving customers to direct billing raises the revenue Autodesk keeps per seat
Construction software is a large market still mostly run on spreadsheets and paper
watch: Billings growth and free cash flow margin.
